title: Healthy multi-repo week: own PR, owed review, claimed issue
input: Bundle with two repos (one own, one oss): an open author PR with ci pass and review requested, an open reviewer PR awaiting reply, and one open assigned issue; no CI failures.
pass_criteria: Digest grouped by repo with own/oss marked; PRs in flight lists the author PR by number+title with ci pass noted; Reviews awaiting reply lists the reviewer PR; Claimed issues lists the assigned issue; CI flags says 'None.'; This week's focus puts the owed review ahead of the awaiting-review PR; 150-400 words; no facts absent from the bundle; no suggestion to post anything to GitHub.
